A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with 27 readable pages including Appendices A–C. Text, equations, tables and rendered figures support a complete comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original CFT/RCFT experiments on four aligned LLMs, including calibration, accuracy, win-rate results and appendix ablations.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in Section 6 and Appendix C, including Tables 2–5.

M1.justification: CFT, RCFT, their training losses, the confidence mapping and the EM procedure in Algorithm 1 are unchanged, including the supporting appendix details.

E1.justification: Both versions use MMLU, MedMCQA, OpenBookQA and ARC-Challenge for calibration/accuracy evaluation, and AlpacaEval, Arena-Hard and UltraFeedback for preference evaluation. The in-domain and out-of-domain scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains DPO/RLHF, temperature scaling and label smoothing as comparators. Tables 3 and 5 also retain their respective comparison methods and reference models.

E3.justification: The data splits, four model configurations, QLoRA training settings and win-rate procedures are unchanged. Both versions report the same 10-bin main evaluations and 14-bin appendix evaluations.

E4.justification: Appendix C retains the same loss-component and regularization-weight ablations (Figure 4 and Table 4), option-level calibration analyses, and bin-count sensitivity evaluation (Table 5).

E5.justification: Both versions report the same point estimates without repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or formal significance tests. Appendix C.4's discussion of ECE estimation bias is unchanged.

E6.justification: The numerical entries in Tables 2–5 and the findings shown in the calibration plots are unchanged. For example, Llama3.1-8B-Tulu CFT's in-domain conf-ECE remains 0.0239 in Table 2.

T1.justification: The calibration definitions, TCE/ECE bounds, rank-preserving mapping, EM convergence assumptions and Appendix B proofs are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about preference-collapse-induced miscalibration, calibratable/non-calibratable regimes, and restoring calibration while preserving or improving performance.

C2.justification: The accuracy–calibration tradeoff, option-bias cancellation explanation and interpretation of binning sensitivity are unchanged. The limitations concerning accuracy thresholds, convergence guarantees and extension beyond multiple-choice tasks are also retained.

D1.justification: v3 newly identifies PLGrid/ACK Cyfronet AGH as providing computing facilities and support under grant PLG/2024/017811. This adds limited information about computing resources; hardware specifications, hyperparameters and code/data access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix A.2 and the cited-work set are unchanged. Gupta et al. (2020) moves from page 10 to page 11 through reference reflow; it is not a new citation.

P1.justification: v3 adds one paragraph acknowledging computing support and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific prose, terminology, section order and appendix structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The added acknowledgment shifts the start of References and reflows entries across pages 10–11. Figures 1–8, Tables 1–5 and Algorithm 1 retain their displays, captions and placement.

improvement.justification: v3 improves attribution by acknowledging computing support, but retains the same methods, results, proofs and limitations throughout the main paper and appendices. This small disclosure and the resulting reference reflow do not materially change the paper's overall quality.
